guarantees.title: 30-Day Walkaway Guarantee
guarantees.summary: No 12-month vendor traps. If you aren't satisfied for any reason—in month one or month twenty—give us 30 days' written notice and walk away cleanly with zero early-termination penalties.

guarantees.title: 24-Hour Re-Clean Promise
guarantees.summary: If an item on your 42-point checklist is ever missed, snap a photo or text us by 10:00 AM. A supervisor or technician returns within 24 hours to re-clean it at zero charge.

guarantees.title: Three-Strike Visit Credit
guarantees.summary: If the same protocol item is ever missed three times in any rolling 60-day window, we automatically credit one full visit off your next monthly invoice—in writing, without you having to argue for it.

homeFaqs.q: How do you handle after-hours building access, keys, and alarm codes?
homeFaqs.a: Every key and keycard is logged with a blind numeric security code—never labeled with your company name or street address—and issued only to your assigned background-checked team lead. Under Point 41 of our protocol, our lead physically pull-tests every perimeter door and photographs the armed alarm keypad before leaving the property.

homeFaqs.q: Do you supply paper towels, toilet tissue, trash liners, and hand soap?
homeFaqs.a: We work whichever way is easiest for your facility: we can restock from your existing janitor closet inventory and alert you when boxes run low (PT. 13), or we can supply commercial paper, liners, and soap directly as a flat monthly add-on.

homeFaqs.q: Do we have to sign a 1-year or 3-year janitorial contract?
homeFaqs.a: No. Long lock-in contracts only protect bad cleaners. Every commercial agreement with Debra's Classic Cleaning includes our 30-Day Walkaway Guarantee—you stay with us because the building passes inspection every morning, not because of fine print.

homeFaqs.q: What happens if something is missed on a night visit?
homeFaqs.a: Text or call 916-668-8080 or reply to your visit scorecard. Under our 24-Hour Re-Clean Guarantee, we dispatch a supervisor or technician within 24 hours to fix it. And under our Three-Strike Credit, if the same item is missed three times in 60 days, that visit is credited off your invoice.

homeFaqs.q: How quickly can you provide a Certificate of Insurance (COI) and W-9?
homeFaqs.a: Within 24 hours—and same business day for urgent post-construction or property management turnovers. We carry commercial general liability, janitorial bonding, and workers' compensation insurance.

homeFaqs.q: What cleaning products and vacuums do you use in medical offices and daycares?
homeFaqs.a: We use CRI-approved commercial HEPA backpack vacuums (trapping 99.97% of particulates down to 0.3 microns), four-color isolated microfiber cloths laundered at 160°F, EPA List N hospital-grade disinfectants for clinics, and fragrance-free EPA DfE non-toxic disinfectants for daycares and preschools.

homeFaqs.q: Will the same people be in my building every week?
homeFaqs.a: Yes. Unlike brokered janitorial franchises that sell your account to rotating subcontractors, we assign a dedicated background-checked W-2 team and route supervisor to your facility.
